topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: The path circles back, much like the tales whispered by the old oak. Seasons turn, and here I stand, where once my own steps were unsure. The same eyes now watch over new beginnings, a familiar gaze kindling the spark that shadows left untended. This circle, it holds more than just ground; it holds memories, woven tight as the roots that cling to the earth. To see the young one tread where I once did, it’s like watching the river flow, always moving yet ever the same. The leaves rustle with approval, as if they too remember the warmth of a guide’s presence, steady and true.
